_README: Committed fallback for F10. Keys are questions normalised to lowercase with collapsed whitespace and no trailing punctuation. Used whenever the model is unavailable - no API key, no network, exhausted quota - so the four scripted demo queries work offline. The answer text here is phrasing only: routers/query.py always recomputes the counts and the entity ids from the live database and appends them, so nothing on screen is a number from a recording.

which people are on record with the poli.interpretation: People held in Gujarat Police records with a connection active from 2023 onward.
which people are on record with the poli.answer: These are the people the police hold records on whose links are still live in or after 2023.

find everyone named rakesh.interpretation: Any person whose name contains Rakesh, across every agency the caller can see.
find everyone named rakesh.answer: Partial name match on Rakesh. Spelling varies between agencies, which is exactly what the resolution queue is for.

show me the telecom call records between.interpretation: Phones involved in a call that overlaps the window from 2020 to the end of 2022.
show me the telecom call records between.answer: Phones with call activity overlapping 2020 to 2022. A call that started earlier and had not ended still counts inside the window.

which vehicles are registered at a known.interpretation: Vehicles with a registered_at link to a location record.
which vehicles are registered at a known.answer: Vehicles the RTO has tied to an address. These are the ones that can be placed somewhere.
